description: Each analyst run pre-registers a condition that would overturn it within its horizon; later runs score it. FIRED means the data did what the analyst said would prove it wrong. NOT_FIRED means the horizon passed and it did not, which is weak evidence for the reading, since most falsifiers sit at levels rarely reached. Derived from runs.json; the dissent log is untouched.
